description:
Query Google Ads performance insights with intelligent query planning. Auto-generates GAQL, handles metric/segment incompatibilities by splitting queries.
Use google-ads://metrics for available metrics, google-ads://dimensions for dimensions.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID (without dashes, e.g., 1234567890)

limit.description: Maximum number of returned items or rows. The declared bounds and default apply; use pagination for additional results.

metrics.description: Metric keys (e.g., impressions, clicks, cost_micros, conversions)

orderBy.description: Optional GAQL field to order by, e.g. metrics.impressions or campaign.name

orderDirection.description: Sort direction for the selected ordering field.

resource.description: GAQL FROM clause resource type (campaign, ad_group, ad_group_ad, keyword_view, shopping_performance_view, asset_group, geographic_view, video, search_term_view, landing_page_view, etc.)

name: google_ads_get_insights

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

title: google ads get insights
